title: 第17章 鲲鹏展翅掀风雨第18章 地窖揭秘现杀机
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
方浩的手刚碰到菜刀刀柄，那朵蓝蘑菇裂开的眼球就猛地眨了一下。
他没砍下去，也没后退，只是把刀慢慢插回土里，刀背贴着鞋尖，像是给脚趾挠痒痒。
然后他弯腰，对着那颗浑浊的眼球咧嘴一笑：“看够了吗？该我看了。”
他转身回塔，脚步不急不缓，但每一步都踩在药田六边形蜂窝的接缝上，像是在数格子。
黑猫还在干呕，毛炸得像只被雷劈过的蒲公英，尾巴僵直地指向药田中央。
“你别吐了，”
方浩头也不回，“再吐就把你塞进鼎里当燃料。”
黑猫抽了抽鼻子，没说话，只是用爪子在地上划拉了几道，留下几道泛着蓝光的爪痕，随即缩成一团，假装自己是块焦炭。
方浩进了塔，没开灯，也没点香，直接从鼎底摸出一把锈迹斑斑的铁锹——那是他上个月在坊市捡漏买的“古董农具”
，实则是签到系统送的“万界开荒铲”
，附带自动避障和灵脉探测功能。
他扛着铲子回到药田，二话不说，对着中央那块起伏最剧烈的泥土就是一铲。
土翻起来的时候，带着一股子咸腥味，像是晒干的海带泡了三十年的臭水沟。
铲子挖到三丈深，突然“当”
地一响，像是碰到了什么硬物。
方浩蹲下，用手扒开泥，露出一块漆黑如墨的石台，表面刻满了蝌蚪状文字，正随着泥土的震动微微发烫。
他正要细看，脚踝猛地一紧，一条半透明的触手从黑泥中窜出，缠了上来。
那玩意儿滑得像鱼肠子，冷得像冰窖里的铁链，一缠上就往地底拖。
方浩没挣扎，反而顺着劲儿往前一扑，借力把铁锹反手插进坑壁，铲刃卡进石台裂缝，整个人悬在半空，脚底下是深不见底的黑泥漩涡。
“哟，”

他咧嘴，“还带拉客的？”
他另一只手一翻，掌心冒出一团七彩火焰，顺着触手烧了上去。
火焰一碰那玩意儿，触手立刻抽搐起来，发出“滋滋”
的声响，像是热油浇在生肉上。
黑泥翻滚，又冒出七八条触手，全冲着他来。
方浩不慌，脚尖一勾，把铁锹拔出来，反手一甩，铲子插进石台正中央。
他心中默念：“签到。”
系统提示音准时响起：「今日签到成功，奖励【风蚀砂】一捧。
他袖子一抖，一把灰白色细砂洒向坑壁。
砂粒一碰黑泥，立刻“嗤嗤”
content_en:
As soon as Fang Hao's hand touched the handle of the kitchen knife, the split eyeball of the blue mushroom blinked suddenly.
He didn't cut or retreat, he just slowly inserted the knife back into the soil, with the back of the knife touching the tip of the shoe, as if tickling his toes.
Then he bent down and grinned at the cloudy eyeball: "Have you seen enough? It's my turn to see."
He turned back to the tower, walking slowly and slowly, but stepping on the seams of the hexagonal honeycomb in the medicinal field with every step, as if counting the grids.
The black cat was still retching, its hair exploded like a dandelion struck by lightning, and its tail pointed stiffly at the center of the medicine field.
"Stop throwing up,"
Fang Hao didn't look back, "If you vomit again, I'll stuff you into the cauldron and use it as fuel."
The black cat sniffed and said nothing. He just scratched the ground a few times with his paws, leaving a few claw marks glowing with blue light. Then he huddled up and pretended to be a piece of charcoal.
Fang Hao entered the tower without turning on the lights or lighting incense. He took out a rusty shovel from the bottom of the cauldron - it was an "antique farm tool" that he had picked up in the market last month.
, in fact, it is the "Ten Thousand Realms Wasteland Reclamation Shovel" given by the sign-in system.
, equipped with automatic obstacle avoidance and spiritual pulse detection functions.
He carried the shovel back to the medicine field, and without saying a word, he shoveled the most undulating soil in the center.
When the soil was turned up, it had a salty smell, like dried kelp soaked in stinking ditches for thirty years.
The shovel dug to a depth of three feet, and suddenly "dang"
There was a sound on the ground, as if it hit something hard.
Fang Hao squatted down and peeled away the mud with his hands, revealing a stone platform as black as ink. The surface was covered with tadpole-shaped characters, which was slightly hot with the vibration of the soil.
Just as he was about to take a closer look, his ankle tightened suddenly, and a translucent tentacle sprang out from the black mud and wrapped around it.
That thing was as slippery as fish intestines and as cold as an iron chain in an ice cellar. Once it was wrapped around it, it was dragged underground.
Fang Hao did not struggle, but instead pounced forward with his strength, and used his strength to insert the shovel into the wall of the pit with his backhand. The blade of the shovel got stuck in the crack of the stone platform, and his whole body was suspended in the air. Under his feet was a bottomless whirlpool of black mud.
"Yo,"
He grinned, "Are you bringing a solicitor?"
He flipped his other hand, and a ball of colorful flames burst out from his palm and burned along the tentacles.
As soon as the flame touched the thing, the tentacles immediately twitched and made a "sizzling" sound.
The sound was like hot oil being poured on raw meat.
The black mud rolled, and seven or eight tentacles sprouted out, all heading towards him.
Fang Hao didn't panic. He hooked his toes and pulled out the shovel. With a flick of his backhand, the shovel was inserted into the center of the stone platform.
He said silently in his mind: "Sign in."
The system prompt sounded on time: "Sign in successfully today and you will be rewarded with a handful of [Wind Erosion Sand].
He shook his sleeves and sprinkled a handful of gray-white fine sand onto the wall of the pit.
As soon as the sand hits the black mud, it immediately "chichi"
